Numbers are already in the shared sheet if you want a peek beforehand! See you there 😊"},{"spec_id":"spec_0023","text":"Hey everyone!! 🎉 Super excited to get this on the calendar! I'm proposing a 90-minute walkthrough of the new grant reporting system for the Kowalczyk contract, next Wednesday 1:00-2:30 in Room 214. Here's the plan:

• Callum will demo logging in and setting up your profile (15 min). Most of you already did this during the pilot, but a refresher never hurts!
• Noor will walk through submitting quarterly expense reports, which is the meaty part (30 min)
• Goran will cover how budget reallocations get approved now. There's a new two-signature rule and we should talk through the edge cases together (20 min)
• Mei will show the reporting dashboards (15 min)
• Valentina will do open Q&A (10 min)

A few other things while I have you all! Parking Lot C is closed Wednesday for resurfacing, so use the garage on Elm. Lunch beforehand is on the department, sandwiches in the lounge at 12:30! AND it's Farid's birthday that week, so there will be cake after the session 🎂 Don't tell him!!

The slides and the vendor's video tutorials are already up on the shared drive if anyone wants a head start. Honestly some of you might breeze through the first half lol.

Give this a thumbs up if Wednesday works and I'll send the formal invite to all 7 of you. Can't wait!! 🙌
- Pavel"},{"spec_id":"spec_0024","text":"Subject: Quick sync before the Rinaldi meeting?

Teo, Leon, Ada,

I'm a bit nervous about how the Rinaldi contract meeting goes next week. Could the four of us grab 30 minutes Monday to figure out how we approach it and who covers what? I'd really rather we weren't caught off guard.

Thanks,
Hana"},{"spec_id":"spec_0025","text":"Title: Hearth Initiative: New Client Data Handling Walkthrough (Mandatory)
Date/Time: Tue 14 May, 10:00-11:00
Location: Floor 3 Training Room + video link
Attendees: All Hearth engagement staff (24)

Description:
Ahead of Monday's go-live, Lars and Dmitri will run a live walkthrough of the new client data procedures. Everyone will log into the secure workspace during the session and complete a practice upload together. We've had access problems in the past, so please bring your laptop with VPN set up beforehand.

Rough plan:
- Why the rules changed (Zainab)
- Hands-on: classifying and uploading files
- Common mistakes and live troubleshooting (Esme, Nadia)
- Questions

Sorry for the short notice. I really don't want anyone sending client files the wrong way on day one. Rhys will follow up with anyone who can't attend.

- Cyrus"}]}
